mdr_mnc_category = {

	# Players see the invitation list only when they ask for it (it would be 28 entries).
	mdr_mnc_toggle_invites = {
		icon = attract_foreign_investor
		cost = 0
		fire_only_once = no
		visible = { is_ai = no }
		complete_effect = {
			if = { limit = { has_country_flag = mdr_mnc_show_invites } clr_country_flag = mdr_mnc_show_invites }
			else = { set_country_flag = mdr_mnc_show_invites }
		}
		ai_will_do = { base = 0 }
	}

	mdr_mnc_nat_exxonmobil = {
		icon = money_dec
		cost = 50
		fire_only_once = no
		visible = { check_variable = { mdr_mnc_exxonmobil > 0 } }
		available = {
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = mdr_mnc_nat_cooldown_tt
				NOT = { has_country_flag = mdr_mnc_nat_cooldown }
			}
		}
		complete_effect = {
			log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: Decision mdr_mnc_nat_exxonmobil"
			add_to_variable = { mdr_mnc_exxonmobil_nat = mdr_mnc_exxonmobil }
			set_variable = { mdr_mnc_exxonmobil = 0 }
			set_variable = { mdr_mnc_exxonmobil_frz = 0 }
			set_country_flag = { flag = mdr_mnc_exxonmobil_out days = 3650 value = 1 }
			set_country_flag = { flag = mdr_mnc_nat_cooldown days = 180 value = 1 }
			add_stability = 0.023
			add_timed_idea = { idea = mdr_mnc_expropriation_risk days = 1825 }
			if = { limit = { country_exists = USA }
				USA = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = mdr_mnc_expropriated } }
			}
		}
		ai_will_do = {
			base = 0
			modifier = { OR = { has_government = communism has_government = nationalist } add = 3 }
			modifier = { has_government = fascism add = 1.3 }
			modifier = { check_variable = { treasury_rate < 0 } NOT = { has_government = democratic } add = 1.7 }
			modifier = { country_exists = USA has_war_with = USA add = 2.3 }
			modifier = { has_government = democratic factor = 0.07 }
			modifier = { has_idea = mdr_mnc_expropriation_risk factor = 0.3 }
		}
	}

	mdr_mnc_inv_exxonmobil = {
		icon = attract_foreign_investor
		cost = 25
		fire_only_once = no
		visible = {
			NOT = { original_tag = USA }
			country_exists = USA
			NOT = { check_variable = { mdr_mnc_exxonmobil > 0 } }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = mdr_mnc_exxonmobil_out }
			OR = { is_ai = yes has_country_flag = mdr_mnc_show_invites }
			any_owned_state = { has_resources_amount = { resource = oil amount > 2 } }
		}
		available = {
			has_stability > 0.41
			has_war = no
			NOT = { has_war_with = USA }
			NOT = { is_embargoed_by = USA }
			USA = { NOT = { is_embargoed_by = ROOT } has_opinion = { target = ROOT value > -10 } }
			mdr_is_under_western_sanctions = no
		}
		complete_effect = {
			log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: Decision mdr_mnc_inv_exxonmobil"
			set_variable = { mdr_mnc_exxonmobil = 1 }
			set_variable = { mdr_mnc_exxonmobil_frz = 0 }
			set_country_flag = { flag = mdr_mnc_exxonmobil_new days = 1095 value = 1 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.mdr_mnc_exxonmobil_h value = THIS } } }
				add_to_array = { global.mdr_mnc_exxonmobil_h = THIS }
			}
		}
		ai_will_do = {
			base = 0
			modifier = { has_government = democratic add = 1.3 }
			modifier = { check_variable = { gdp_per_capita < 7 } add = 1.1 }
			modifier = { OR = { has_government = communism has_government = nationalist } factor = 0.13 }
			modifier = { has_idea = mdr_mnc_expropriation_risk factor = 0 }
		}
	}

			set_variable = { mdr_mnc_cogema_frz = 0 }
			set_country_flag = { flag = mdr_mnc_cogema_out days = 3650 value = 1 }
			set_country_flag = { flag = mdr_mnc_nat_cooldown days = 180 value = 1 }
			add_stability = 0.023
			add_timed_idea = { idea = mdr_mnc_expropriation_risk days = 1825 }
			if = { limit = { country_exists = FRA }
				FRA = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = mdr_mnc_expropriated } }
			}
		}
		ai_will_do = {
			base = 0
			modifier = { OR = { has_government = communism has_government = nationalist } add = 3 }
			modifier = { has_government = fascism add = 1.3 }
			modifier = { check_variable = { treasury_rate < 0 } NOT = { has_government = democratic } add = 1.7 }
			modifier = { country_exists = FRA has_war_with = FRA add = 2.3 }
			modifier = { has_government = democratic factor = 0.07 }
			modifier = { has_idea = mdr_mnc_expropriation_risk factor = 0.3 }
		}

			NOT = { check_variable = { mdr_mnc_nokia > 0 } }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = mdr_mnc_nokia_out }
			OR = { is_ai = yes has_country_flag = mdr_mnc_show_invites }
		}
		available = {
			has_stability > 0.41
			has_war = no
			NOT = { has_war_with = FIN }
			NOT = { is_embargoed_by = FIN }
			FIN = { NOT = { is_embargoed_by = ROOT } has_opinion = { target = ROOT value > -10 } }
			mdr_is_under_western_sanctions = no
		}
		complete_effect = {
			log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: Decision mdr_mnc_inv_nokia"
			set_variable = { mdr_mnc_nokia = 1 }
			set_variable = { mdr_mnc_nokia_frz = 0 }
			set_country_flag = { flag = mdr_mnc_nokia_new days = 1095 value = 1 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.mdr_mnc_nokia_h value = THIS } } }
				add_to_array = { global.mdr_mnc_nokia_h = THIS }
			}
		}
		ai_will_do = {
			base = 0
			modifier = { has_government = democratic add = 1.3 }
			modifier = { check_variable = { gdp_per_capita < 7 } add = 1.1 }
			modifier = { OR = { has_government = communism has_government = nationalist } factor = 0.13 }
			modifier = { has_idea = mdr_mnc_expropriation_risk factor = 0 }
		}
	}

}
